### Problem to solve

What were you trying to understand or do when you hit this gap?

### Proposed solution

What should WebTrace do? Keep the honesty doctrine in mind: if the idea
requires data the browser cannot observe, describe how it should be labeled
(derived) or which optional instrumentation it needs.

### Alternatives considered

Other ways this could work.

### Teaching value

WebTrace is a teaching tool as much as a debugging tool — does this feature
help someone understand the web better?
